test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Plants use a completely different process for excretion as compared to animals. Which of the following processes is NOT followed by plants for excretion?

options.text: Filter toxic substances through the leaves
Excrete some waste into the soil
Excess water thrown out by transpiration

solution:
The incorrect answer is **'__Filter toxic substances through the leaves__'.**
